updates.message: The boxes are full. There are lots and lots of things, though most of them stripped. A few CD/DVD players if you're in the market for one, though! Recently there was also a stack of vinyl the other day, in other words lots of activity!

Huge PC case on the side, besides that, there are a few monitors, printers, and videotape/film, still persisting nearly a semester later. Some kind of phone conferencing equipment, too from the looks of it.

Low has 4 boxes currently. The first one you'll see has a bunch of TVs, the second is from the VCC once upon a time, it seems, and the remaining 2 boxes have a bunch of random shells and things. Perhaps a keyboard or two, too.
There's some Sun Microsystems server-looking computers filling the box, and a bunch of wires including phone wires and what looks like ethernet cables.
The boxes are still pretty full from before break, most of the stuff from then is still there. There is a xerox photocopier precariously inside the boxes now, though!
Cogswell still quite empty. Literally like 3 things in there, 2 out of those 3 are scraps. Literally no change since before break.
Some wires and an old looking printer make up most of what's in here today.
In West, printers, string lights, a DVD player (find of the week last semester?). There's an AC unit, some trashed laptops, and a smashed flatscreen TV. Lots of wires, too.
There's a printer and 3 network switches.
